title: COP Proposed Updates March 2026
abstract: Draft consultation document outlining proposed amendments to the Traffic Management for Works on Roads Code of Practice, scheduled for official release in March 2026. Provides advance notice of anticipated changes to traffic management practices for road works in Western Australia. Intended to facilitate industry consultation and feedback prior to finalization of amendments. The current May 2025 edition remains the authoritative reference until official release.
note: External document - no local file for section extraction

keyRequirements.requirement: Review proposed amendments during consultation period
Continue compliance with current May 2025 edition until official release
Monitor MRWA communications for consultation timeline

complianceNotes.note: This document is a draft for consultation purposes only and has no regulatory effect
Current May 2025 edition of the Code of Practice remains legally binding
